nodes.name: Craft
nodes.description: Skilled making by hand, encompassing decorative, functional, and fiber arts.

nodes.name: Ceramics
nodes.description: The art of shaping and firing clay into vessels, sculpture, and tiles.

nodes.name: Pottery
nodes.description: The craft of making functional and decorative clay vessels.

nodes.name: Earthenware
nodes.description: Low-fired porous clay ware.

nodes.name: Stoneware
nodes.description: High-fired vitrified clay ware, durable and non-porous.

nodes.name: Porcelain
nodes.description: Fine white translucent clay ware, perfected in China.

nodes.name: Raku Ware
nodes.description: Japanese low-fired pottery with rapid cooling and crackled glaze.

nodes.name: Glazing
nodes.description: Coating ceramic ware with a glassy surface before firing.

nodes.name: Kiln Firing
nodes.description: Hardening clay through controlled heating in a kiln.

nodes.name: Wheel Throwing
nodes.description: Shaping clay on a rotating potter's wheel.

nodes.name: Hand Building
nodes.description: Shaping clay by hand through coiling, pinching, and slabbing.

nodes.name: Textile Arts
nodes.description: Arts of creating fabric and decorating it through weaving, stitching, and dyeing.

nodes.name: Weaving
nodes.description: Interlacing warp and weft threads to form cloth.

nodes.name: Embroidery
nodes.description: Decorating fabric with needle and thread.

nodes.name: Quilting
nodes.description: Stitching layers of fabric and batting into padded textiles.

nodes.name: Knitting
nodes.description: Creating fabric from interlocking loops of yarn.

nodes.name: Crochet
nodes.description: Creating fabric with a hooked needle from looped yarn.

nodes.name: Tapestry
nodes.description: Weft-faced weaving producing pictorial hangings.

nodes.name: Batik
nodes.description: Wax-resist dyeing of fabric, notably Javanese.

nodes.name: Tie-Dye
nodes.description: Dyeing fabric bound to create resist patterns.

nodes.name: Lace Making
nodes.description: Creating openwork fabric of threads.

nodes.name: Feltmaking
nodes.description: Matting wool fibers into nonwoven fabric.

nodes.name: Spinning
nodes.description: Twisting fibers into yarn or thread.

nodes.name: Dyeing
nodes.description: Coloring fibers and fabric with natural or synthetic dyes.

nodes.name: Glass Art
nodes.description: Art made by shaping molten or cold glass.

nodes.name: Glassblowing
nodes.description: Inflating molten glass into vessels and forms.

nodes.name: Glass Casting
nodes.description: Forming glass by pouring or slumping into molds.

nodes.name: Fused Glass
nodes.description: Bonding pieces of glass by heating in a kiln.

nodes.name: Lampworking
nodes.description: Shaping glass rods over a torch flame.

nodes.name: Metalwork
nodes.description: Crafting objects from metal by forging, casting, and shaping.

nodes.name: Blacksmithing
nodes.description: Forging iron and steel by hammering heated metal.

nodes.name: Goldsmithing
nodes.description: Working gold into jewelry and precious objects.

nodes.name: Silversmithing
nodes.description: Working silver into vessels and tableware.

nodes.name: Bronze Casting
nodes.description: Casting molten bronze into sculptures and objects.

nodes.name: Enameling
nodes.description: Fusing powdered glass onto metal surfaces.

nodes.name: Woodworking
nodes.description: Crafting objects from wood.

nodes.name: Carpentry
nodes.description: Cutting and joining wood for structures and furniture.

nodes.name: Joinery
nodes.description: Joining wood pieces with fitted joints.

nodes.name: Wood Carving
nodes.description: Carving wood into decorative and sculptural forms.

nodes.name: Marquetry
nodes.description: Inlaying veneers to form decorative patterns.

nodes.name: Jewelry
nodes.description: Personal adornment crafted from metal, gems, and other materials.

nodes.name: Gem Setting
nodes.description: Mounting gemstones into jewelry.

nodes.name: Filigree
nodes.description: Delicate metalwork of twisted fine wire.

nodes.name: Lacquerware
nodes.description: Objects coated with hardened tree-sap lacquer, often decorated.

nodes.name: Urushi
nodes.description: Japanese lacquer art using the sap of the urushi tree.

nodes.name: Papermaking
nodes.description: The craft of forming sheets of paper from fiber pulp.

nodes.name: Bookbinding
nodes.description: Assembling and covering pages into bound books.

nodes.name: Basketry
nodes.description: Weaving baskets and containers from plant fibers.

nodes.name: Leatherwork
nodes.description: Crafting objects from tanned animal hides.

nodes.name: Origami
nodes.description: Japanese art of folding paper into sculptural forms.

nodes.name: Ikebana
nodes.description: Japanese art of disciplined flower arrangement.
